candidate_claims.statement: Fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva is a disorder in which muscle tissue and connective tissue such as tendons and ligaments are gradually replaced by bone (ossified), forming bone outside the skeleton (extra-skeletal or heterotopic bone) that limits movement.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: Fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva is a disorder in which muscle tissue and connective tissue such as tendons and ligaments are gradually replaced by bone (ossified), forming bone outside the skeleton (extra-skeletal or heterotopic bone) that limits movement.

candidate_claims.statement: This process generally becomes noticeable in early childhood, starting with the neck and shoulders and proceeding down the body and into the limbs.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: This process generally becomes noticeable in early childhood, starting with the neck and shoulders and proceeding down the body and into the limbs.

candidate_claims.statement: Extra-skeletal bone formation causes progressive loss of mobility as the joints become affected.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: Extra-skeletal bone formation causes progressive loss of mobility as the joints become affected.

candidate_claims.statement: Inability to fully open the mouth may cause difficulty in speaking and eating.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: Inability to fully open the mouth may cause difficulty in speaking and eating.

candidate_claims.statement: Over time, people with this disorder may experience malnutrition due to their eating problems.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: Over time, people with this disorder may experience malnutrition due to their eating problems.

candidate_claims.statement: They may also have breathing difficulties as a result of extra bone formation around the rib cage that restricts expansion of the lungs.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: They may also have breathing difficulties as a result of extra bone formation around the rib cage that restricts expansion of the lungs.

candidate_claims.statement: Any trauma to the muscles of an individual with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva, such as a fall or invasive medical procedures, may trigger episodes of muscle swelling and inflammation (myositis) followed by more rapid ossification in the injured area.

candidate_claims.statement: Flare-ups may also be caused by viral illnesses such as influenza.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: Flare-ups may also be caused by viral illnesses such as influenza.

candidate_claims.statement: People with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva are generally born with malformed big toes.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: People with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva are generally born with malformed big toes.

candidate_claims.statement: This abnormality of the big toes is a characteristic feature that helps to distinguish this disorder from other bone and muscle problems.

candidate_claims.statement: Affected individuals may also have short thumbs and other skeletal abnormalities.

candidate_claims.statement: Fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva is a very rare disorder, believed to occur in approximately 1 in 1 million people worldwide.
